data.description: Your dander is highly irritating to all creatures save those with the goblinoid subtype. A non-goblinoid creature damaged by your bite, who deals damage to you with a natural weapon or unarmed attack, or who otherwise comes into contact with you (including attempts to grapple or ride you) must make a DC %1 Fortitude save or break out in an itching rash. A creature affected by this rash takes a -2 penalty to Dexterity and Charisma for 1 day (multiple allergic reactions do not stack). Remove disease or any magical healing removes the rash instantly. This is a disease effect.
data.name: Allergic Reaction
